<a id="advancetrustedc2spcheckpoint"></a>

### advanceTrustedC2spCheckpoint()

```ts
function advanceTrustedC2spCheckpoint(
   store, 
   reference, 
   checkpoint, 
   witnessTime, 
options?): Promise<TrustedC2spCheckpoint>;
```

Defined in: [packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/checkpoint-trust.ts:70](https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-ts/blob/main/packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/checkpoint-trust.ts#L70)

Advances the stored trusted checkpoint for a log origin to `checkpoint`,
guarding against split-view and rollback attacks: a same-size checkpoint
must have the same root, and a larger one must be proven consistent by a
consistency proof or a complete scan matching both checkpoint prefixes.

#### Parameters

##### store

[`TrustedC2spCheckpointStore`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#trustedc2spcheckpointstore)

##### reference

[`ParsedC2spTlogLr`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#parsedc2sptloglr)

##### checkpoint

[`Checkpoint`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#checkpoint-1)

##### witnessTime

`Date`

##### options?

[`VerificationOptions`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-interfaces/#verificationoptions) & `object` = `{}`

#### Returns

`Promise`\<[`TrustedC2spCheckpoint`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#trustedc2spcheckpoint)\>

A defensive copy of the newly trusted checkpoint.

#### Throws

C2spTlogVerificationError on origin mismatch, rollback, root
  divergence, or missing/invalid consistency evidence.

<a id="createc2sptlogverificationregistry"></a>

### createC2spTlogVerificationRegistry()

```ts
function createC2spTlogVerificationRegistry(options): Promise<LogRegistry>;
```

Defined in: [packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/verification-registry.ts:87](https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-ts/blob/main/packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/verification-registry.ts#L87)

Creates a [LogRegistry](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-classes/#logregistry) ready to verify `c2sp-tlog` lifecycle
references. Trust policy is explicit and never inferred from an identity
record, its `lr`, or the log prefix.

The default resource fetcher rejects unsafe destinations and redirects,
connects through the validated DNS result, requires HTTP 200, bounds decoded
bodies while reading, and applies finite request deadlines. The default
checkpoint store is restart-ephemeral; inject durable storage when rollback
protection must survive process restarts.

#### Parameters

##### options

[`C2spTlogVerificationOptions`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#c2sptlogverificationoptions)

#### Returns

`Promise`\<[`LogRegistry`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-classes/#logregistry)\>

<a id="creatednsidmanagedverificationregistry"></a>

### createDnsidManagedVerificationRegistry()

```ts
function createDnsidManagedVerificationRegistry(options?): Promise<LogRegistry>;
```

Defined in: [packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/managed-verification-registry.ts:56](https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-ts/blob/main/packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/managed-verification-registry.ts#L56)

Creates a registry for the reviewed trust roots of Identity Digital-managed
DNSid logs. Calling this separately named factory is an explicit application
trust decision; the generic factory never selects these roots implicitly.

Trust snapshots are bundled with the SDK and selected only after parsing an
exact canonical `(scope, logPrefix)` pair. Managed verification prefers
signed stream bundles with safe raw-scan fallback.

#### Parameters

##### options?

[`DnsidManagedVerificationOptions`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#dnsidmanagedverificationoptions) = `{}`

#### Returns

<a id="enforcecheckpointpolicy"></a>

### enforceCheckpointPolicy()

```ts
function enforceCheckpointPolicy(
   checkpoint, 
   origin, 
   policy, 
   scope, 
   nowMs?, 
   maxClockSkewMs?): CheckpointPolicyResult;
```

Defined in: [packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/policy.ts:113](https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-ts/blob/main/packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/policy.ts#L113)

Enforces the local trust policy on a parsed checkpoint: origin and scope
match, a valid signature from an accepted log key, and a satisfied witness
quorum of timestamped cosignatures no further than `maxClockSkewMs` in the
future. Public scope additionally requires a non-empty quorum rule.

#### Parameters

##### checkpoint

[`Checkpoint`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#checkpoint-1)

##### origin

`string`

##### policy

[`C2spTlogPolicy`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#c2sptlogpolicy)

##### scope

`string`

##### nowMs?

`number` = `...`

##### maxClockSkewMs?

`number` = `0`

#### Returns

[`CheckpointPolicyResult`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#checkpointpolicyresult)

The accepted witness timestamps and derived checkpoint witness time.

#### Throws

C2spTlogVerificationError when any requirement is not met.

inbound MIGRATION), every event signature must verify against the entity or
operational key active at that point, KEY_ROTATION must prove possession of
the new key, every scope must carry consistent seq/prev_* fields,
and nothing may follow a terminal REVOCATION/RETIREMENT. MIGRATION is valid
only as verified inbound genesis in the destination stream.

<a id="verifystreamlifecycle"></a>

### verifyStreamLifecycle()

```ts
function verifyStreamLifecycle(
   entries, 
   domain, 
options?): Promise<VerifiedLifecycleEvent[]>;
```

Defined in: [packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/stream-verifier.ts:162](https://github.com/dnsid-ai/dnsid-ts/blob/main/packages/log-c2sp-tlog/src/stream-verifier.ts#L162)

Extracts and verifies the lifecycle history for one agent domain from
entries already authenticated by the accepted completeness mechanism:
entries are processed in index order, other domains are skipped, identical
signed payloads are deduplicated, and each candidate must keep the accumulated lifecycle valid
under [verifyLifecycle](#verifylifecycle). A malformed entry that nevertheless carries a
valid signatures for every role under verified predecessor authority is
treated as a lifecycle violation, not skipped.

#### Parameters

##### entries

[`IndexedEntry`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#indexedentry)[]

##### domain

`string`

##### options?

[`StreamVerifierOptions`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#streamverifieroptions) = `{}`

#### Returns

`Promise`\<[`VerifiedLifecycleEvent`](https://docs.dnsid.ai/reference/ts/dnsid-log-c2sp-tlog-interfaces/#verifiedlifecycleevent)[]\>

The accepted events in log order.

#### Throws

C2spTlogVerificationError when the resulting lifecycle is invalid
  (for example no ISSUANCE event survives).
